_comment: Per-image facts for the Boquete pages, written after viewing every file. `label` is the short subject line; `desc` is the sentence used as alt text, as the visible caption under the photo and on the gallery tile, and in the 'About these photographs' block. `place` comes from PROVENANCE (our own photographs are of Boquete; Commons files use their geotag or description) and never from guessing at the pixels — the descriptions themselves never name a place the image does not show. _en fields are the English; the bare fields are Spanish.
